entry.author: AUT - Auckland University of Technology
entry.summary:
What does it take to introduce humanoid robots into a university? 

In this first episode, we go behind the scenes at Auckland University of Technology (AUT) as we begin working with New Zealand's first humanoid robot programme. 

Join Dan, AUT's Lead Robotics Technician, as he introduces AUTo and AUTaia, takes the robots into the real world, and gives an inside look at the people building the programme from the ground up. 

Along the way you'll meet: 

• Professor Damon Salesa, Vice-Chancellor of AUT, on why robotics matters for New Zealand's future. 

• Abby Dowd, Senior Director of the AI Acceleration Centre, explaining why embodied AI is the next frontier beyond generative AI. 

• Dr Julia Ma, who leads AUT's robotics teaching programme, as students begin programming both humanoid and quadruped robots. 

This series follows the real journey of bringing humanoid robotics into teaching, research and industry engagement. You'll see the successes, the failures, the unexpected moments and everything in between. 

If you're interested in robotics, artificial intelligence, engineering or the future of technology, subscribe and follow the journey.
